svg.title: Hodge v1.1.0 · Figure 6 · The Bit Delivered Twice: Two Kinds And No Third
svg.text: FIGURE 6
THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE: TWO KINDS AND NO THIRD
HODGE · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
STEP 10 · THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE, BY ITS TWO KINDS, AND NO THIRD
KIND 1 · THE FORMAL CARGO
The record's value carried to the host's frame. It arrives free, the
antecedent a theorem; it gives the Hodge sentence in one step; and it is
exactly the sentence.

svg.text: KIND 2 · THE PHYSICAL WITNESS
Carried by the register of the Riemann row: each class held on the seat of
conjugation, the line of its weight, every registration priced at the
Landauer floor, no class registered without its cycle. Its last field is the bit
read in the register of weight, carried as a field, never proved.

svg.text: The two kinds are one bit
The physical witness is a formal cargo, and the
cargo is exactly the sentence.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Two kinds and no third
Every witness of the sentence, in any vocabulary, is
a delivery of both kinds.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The one refuter
One class without its cycle refutes both kinds at
once, and the sentence itself.

svg.text: THE WITNESSES OF THE SUBJECT, TYPED · EACH STRICTLY STRONGER, SHORT OF THE BIT, OR SEALED
The retired witness axiom
The semiregular witness axiom gives the value and
is strictly stronger; it is retired.

svg.text: Integrality and the (1,1) slice
Integrality does not transfer; the slice decides its
slice and nothing beyond it.

svg.text: The cited fields
They decide every outer codimension in every
dimension and leave every middle codimension
unforced.
